items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice with no setbacks from torn hamstring (missed prior three games); listed Q but ready.
items.why: Full practice week, took starter reps; sources confirm plan to start.
items.implication: QB1 upside return; boosts CHI pass-catchers like Odunze/Moore/Burden in high total spot.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for Rome Odunze and other WRs with Williams back under center.

items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve; out for the foreseeable future with superficial blood clot in calf. Tanner McKee starts vs Panthers.
items.why: Blood clot consultations finalized Saturday; multi-week absence likely.
items.implication: McKee starts; no rushing upside for QB spot. PHI skill players lose dual-threat QB.
items.opportunity: Volume to DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Dontayvion Wicks if healthy; Dameon Pierce as RB lead with Barkley also out.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown to 53-man roster; expected to play Sunday vs Jets after IR stint for high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Practiced limited all week; official activation Saturday.
items.implication: Immediate WR2/flex start in most formats; NE near full health with Henderson likely.
items.opportunity: Primary target share boost in NE offense; elevates Maye/targets overall.

items.text: Bucs RB Sean Tucker (quad) listed questionable and not expected to go today vs Steelers, sources say.
items.implication: Elevates Bucky Irving/Kenny Gainwell if applicable; check TB RB depth.
items.opportunity: More snaps/carries to primary TB RBs.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) and WR Chris Olave (illness) both listed questionable but both expected to play vs Giants, sources say.
items.why: Sunday morning sources confirm expected despite Q tags.
items.implication: Start both in most formats; reverse any handcuff/backup ramps.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/targets for Kamara and Olave; limits Kendre Miller/Devin Neal upside.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) and LT Will Campbell (ankle), both Q, are likely to play vs Jets; NE close to full health with AJ Brown returning.
items.implication: RB2/flex viable; reduces Rhamondre solo upside slightly but committee remains.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes shared; goal-line possible with health.

items.text: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins (ankle) will workout pregame to determine status; practiced just once this week. DT Mason Graham not expected.
items.why: Limited practice; Sunday sources on pregame test.
items.implication: Monitor 90-min inactive window; if out, handcuff/backup volume spike.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated carries for other CLE RBs.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin) for Texans; confirmed on injury reports and inactives context.
items.implication: Avoid; handcuff/backup (e.g. Marks) volume up vs JAX.

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Browns.
items.why: Official activation; Lamar still OUT so Huntley under center.
items.implication: Depth WR with Lamar out; limited but possible targets.
items.opportunity: Routes in BAL offense missing Jackson.

items.text: Berry: Pick up Tanner McKee in any league needing QB; will be better than you think. Not worried about any Eagles skill players with McKee. Start AJ Brown if active as WR2.
items.why: McKee can play; skill guys fine; AJB active start.
items.opportunity: Pass volume to top PHI weapons under McKee.

items.text: Levitan on ETR injury list: Unclear on AJ Brown/Henderson/DJ Moore Qs. Bunch of Qs more like probable (Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle). Tyler Warren Friday Q add. PIT missing WRs so 2-WR sets with Metcalf. McKee has top-4 PHI pass-catchers healthy (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) despite 4th-string RB Pierce.
items.implication: Lean start on probable-Qs; PHI pass game intact for fantasy.
items.opportunity: Full roles for listed; Metcalf target spike in 2-WR.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT (ankle) for Ravens vs Browns; confirmed across reports.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts; downgrade BAL pass game slightly, Zay Flowers still viable.
items.opportunity: Huntley checkdowns may boost Andrews/Likely/Flowers volume.

items.text: Saquon Barkley OUT (hamstring) along with Hurts/Shipley for Eagles; Dameon Pierce leads backfield.
items.implication: Avoid; Pierce gets bulk but poor OL/McKee environment.

items.text: Steelers optimistic TE Pat Freiermuth (calf, added Saturday) will play vs Bucs, sources say.
items.why: Sources despite late addition to report.
items.implication: TE start viable; PIT 2-WR sets likely with other WRs out.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes for Freiermuth in limited WR room.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4) due to Commanders defense being a nightmare for WRs; strong usage and matchup.
items.why: WSH secondary buffet for pass catchers; Evans role bankable.

items.text: Berry loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) for bankable usage in favorable spot.
items.why: Usage you can bank on; solid matchup.

items.text: Berry loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage and leaky run D.
items.why: Volume elite; ARI run D soft.

items.text: Berry hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) due to tough matchup and QB issues.
items.why: Seattle D problem; shaky QB situation.
items.implication: Sit/fade in favor of better options.
